property: Every committed command remains represented in the committed history after admissible crash/restart and later elections; no later successful read or applied history may omit or replace it.
method: Record committed identities from quorum evidence and completed client writes; after recovery require the corresponding immutable committed prefix and linearizable sequential final reads. Storage effects must meet RaftStorage's documented contract.
witness_requirements: Commit quorum for the lost command, real delete and append calls, durable storage snapshots before/after death, fresh recovery/election evidence, recovered/applied prefix and client observation.
